## Close evidence: merged and independently re-verified

- Gerrit change 1403, MERGED 2026-08-05 01:44:10 UTC, LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
- Landed as commit 18f08d57c0 carrying trailer rebar-ticket: d772-6007-5d04-4101.

Re-verified against the merged tree by a third party (not the implementing agent):
- AC1: scripts/probe-rebar.sh is absent from the tree.
- AC2: a repo-wide STRING grep for "probe-rebar" returns four hits, and NONE is an
  invocation -- CHANGELOG.md:190 (historical entry), pyproject.toml:445 (a comment noting
  scripts/probe_rebar.py is the port), scripts/probe_rebar.py:2 (docstring), and a docs
  experiment corpus line quoting old AC text. A targeted grep across .github/ and Makefile
  returns nothing, so no workflow or make target invokes it. The Python port
  scripts/probe_rebar.py is the live replacement.
- AC3 is operator-attested; the change carries Verified +1, which is the CI signal.

The string-grep step matters here specifically: per AGENTS.md the LSP cannot see a shell
script invoked by name, so a semantic-only check would have reported a clean result it could
not actually justify.
